+    o.save(str(OUT / tag))
+    return o
+
+def act(n=1, dx=0.0, dy=0.0, dz=0.0, grip=-1.0, tag="move"):
+    assert n > 0
+    a = np.tile(np.array([dx, dy, dz, grip], dtype=np.float64), (int(n), 1))
+    res = r.submit("ee_delta", a, dt=dt, cameras=cams, video="both", note=tag)

+    """Approximate a world-frame move at <= 1 cm per control step."""
+    p = r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none").meta["proprio"]
+    q = dict(zip(p["layout"], p["now"]))
+    cur = np.array([q["mocap_x"], q["mocap_y"], q["mocap_z"]], dtype=float)
+    dest = cur.copy()
+    for i, v in enumerate((x,y,z)):
